_notes: Hyperspace flight of the flagship, recorded by running UQM's own ship_preprocess, sis_hyper_preprocess, inertial_thrust, init_sis and MoveSIS (see tools/extract/golden/flight.c).
input: [frames, flags] steps; flags 1 left, 2 right, 4 thrust.
ship: characteristics init_sis derives from the drive and jet slots, in hyperspace.

frames: one entry per frame after it is processed: [facing, velocity dx, velocity dy (velocity units, 1/32 world unit), log_x, log_y, fuel (1/100 units), status flags (1 left, 2 right, 4 thrust, 128 at max speed, 256 beyond max speed), turn_wait, thrust_wait].
Screen is UQM's default 320x240; the hyperspace view and its per-frame scroll limit depend on it.
